purpose: Separate mission complexity from the choice-space size presented to each method.

base_node_descriptions.MoveTo: Effect: Navigates to one supplied pose. Applicability: A map- or robot-frame pose is the requested destination.
base_node_descriptions.MoveToGPS: Effect: Navigates to one supplied geographic pose or a complete geographic route. Applicability: One or more latitude-longitude GPS goals are requested.
base_node_descriptions.PublishWaypointMarkers: Effect: Publishes numbered waypoint arrows and a route line for operator review. Applicability: A mission supplies map-frame or geographic waypoints that should be visualized.
base_node_descriptions.TakePicture: Effect: Saves one camera image to disk. Applicability: The mission requests a single visible-light photograph.
base_node_descriptions.TakePhoto: Effect: Saves one camera image to disk. Applicability: Alias used when the mission requests a single visible-light photograph.
base_node_descriptions.DistanceTraveled: Effect: Reports success when the configured odometry distance interval is reached. Applicability: An action must repeat by traveled distance.
base_node_descriptions.GetCurrentPose: Effect: Returns the robot's current localized pose. Applicability: Current map-frame position or derived observation poses are required.
base_node_descriptions.LogTemperature: Effect: Reads and persists a temperature sample. Applicability: The mission requests temperature logging.
base_node_descriptions.RestartNode: Effect: Restarts one named ROS node. Applicability: The mission explicitly requests recovery of that node.
base_node_descriptions.ParseWaypoints: Effect: Parses inline map-frame waypoints into an iteration queue. Applicability: The mission supplies x,y,yaw waypoint tuples.
base_node_descriptions.ParseGpsWaypoints: Effect: Parses inline geographic waypoints into an iteration queue. Applicability: The mission supplies latitude-longitude GPS tuples.

m1_action_library.distractor_selection: Use the first action_node_count minus 11 entries from the frozen distractor catalogue.
m1_action_library.control_node_policy: BehaviorTree.CPP control nodes and their order are identical in every condition and are not included in action_node_count.

node_order.pairing_rule: Use the same hash rank for shared nodes across all scale levels, models, and repetitions of a mission paraphrase.

variants.label: minimal_relevant
variants.catalogue_rule: Expected tree plus one incompatible current tree.

variants.label: current_system
variants.catalogue_rule: All seven current tree templates: six Husky and one BlueBoat.

variants.label: expanded_distractors
variants.catalogue_rule: Current catalogue plus versioned metadata-only distractors.
variants.blocker: Synthetic tree metadata and its frozen order have not been specified yet.

confound_control: Use the same mission, context, model, provider, prompt wording, and repetition index across variants. For M1 change only the declared custom-node library; for M3 change only the tree catalogue.
freeze_requirement: Freeze this file, the distractor catalogue, and the runner before scored runs.
